description:
The water demons were formerly peaceful inhabitants harmed through human greed. Their grievance is real; their present violence also harms people who did not commit the original wrong. Whether that former community was human, Pokémon or both remains open, as do the transformation and the identity of individual entities. Ordinary Water and Ghost Pokémon are not automatically members of this group.

Proposed development: distinguish encounters by what the player can witness rather than an invented rank system. One entity might remain near a repeatedly stripped place while another reaches a populated landing. A person who sees only the second would describe an unprovoked attack; late evidence from the first could expand that account without excusing the harm. The precise behaviors should follow the chosen ancient wrong, not pre-empt it. The final adversary is not automatically their sole mind or the Water/Ghost legendary.

data.description: Proposed late remains can reveal the inhabitants’ former lives. Their composition, transformation and relationship to any specific site remain unresolved.

sections: Sections 2–3: confirmed foundations, origin distinctions and unresolved cosmology
§§3.1–3.2 and 4: real grievance, harm to innocents and unresolved identities. Contrasting encounter behaviors are proposed.
